summary: V6.25.34 — Concept Forge V2 (multi-field) + Smart Validators tested end-to-end. Backend pytest: 11/11 PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_v62534_forge_v2_validators.py (4 forge V2 + 7 validators). V6.25.33 regression: 13/15 PASS (2 legitimately skipped). Frontend: ConceptForge V2 page renders all 10 multi-field grid testids (forge-field-{role|signature_traits|appearance|origin|carried_gear|goals|dreams|personality_knots|history|concept_text}), forge-primer-banner displays 'Power · Heroic / Genre / Era' tags, forge-codex-toggle opens forge-codex-picker. ValidationPanel testid character-validation-panel renders on a dirty BESM character sheet showing over_benchmark_attr (Massive Damage L9>L6), over_benchmark_stat (Body 15>8), over_benchmark_defect (Vulnerability R5>R3); Dismiss button works and persists across reload (4→3 warnings then stays 3 after reload). Panel correctly hides on a clean sheet. Backend covers all V2 schema additions: candidates carry appearance/origin/goals/dreams/personality_knots/history + attributes with resistance_kind+range_kind + power_packs/items/weapons (with is_weapon_item flag). Empty brief → 400 'concept field required'. imported_codex_node_ids passed end-to-end without 500. Validators correctly exempt weapon-tagged rows (L25 'Weapon' attribute NOT flagged). Dismissal signature includes level so a bumped Massive Damage L9→L10 fires fresh warning even after L9 was dismissed.

ui_bugs.issue: duplicate_attribute warning (Tough listed twice) is returned by GET /characters/{cid}/validations but not rendered in the UI panel — only over_benchmark_attr/stat/defect rows show. Verify the panel filter/render logic includes kind==='duplicate_attribute'.

action_items: ValidationPanel.jsx: verify it renders rows with kind='duplicate_attribute' — backend returns the warning but UI omits it (saw 3 of 4 on a dirty sheet that backend reported 4 warnings for).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/concept_forge.py: ConceptForgeIn.has_content() is correctly enforced; brief / primer_snapshot / imported_codex_node_ids all persist on the draft document for audit. JSON fence stripping + regex salvage retained from V6.25.33.

routes/character_validators.py: signature scheme (kind:name:level) gives the right idempotency for benchmark rows (level bump re-fires) and stable dismissal for duplicates (kind:name only). Weapon exemption is name/category/kind contains 'weapon' — works. Defect cap is hardcoded to 3; if a campaign wants a higher cap, this would need a primer override.
Both endpoints scope correctly: /characters/{cid}/validations allows owner OR GM/admin; /campaigns/{cid}/validations is GM-only (403 verified).
Frontend ConceptForge V2 form: the 10-field grid is well-organised, primer banner is tag-style, codex picker collapses by default — clean UX.
Minor: ValidationPanel may be filtering kind=duplicate_attribute (or it requires a separate fixture path). Backend GET correctly returns it; UI does not show it on the dirty sheet.

success_rate.backend: 100% (11/11 V6.25.34 + 13/13 V6.25.33 regression — 2 V6.25.33 cross-persona tests legitimately skipped)
success_rate.frontend: ~95% — all V6.25.34 review-criteria verified in UI; one minor render gap (duplicate_attribute kind) on ValidationPanel

rca of the issue: ValidationPanel rendering 3 of 4 warnings on a dirty sheet whose backend GET returns all 4. RCA: likely a kind allow-list or switch statement in ValidationPanel.jsx that omits 'duplicate_attribute'. Reproduction: POST /api/characters with two attrs 'Tough' L3 + 'Tough' L2 + body=15 + Vulnerability rank=5. GET /api/characters/{id}/validations returns 4 warnings (verified in backend pytest). UI renders 3. Fix scope: small — extend the panel's render switch to include kind='duplicate_attribute'.
